tweet_summary: Eric Daugherty quotes Trump's 21 March 2026 ultimatum to Iran: open the Strait of Hormuz within 48 hours or US will hit Iranian power plants. The attached video shows Trump's Truth Social post text overlaid on infrared strike footage. The quote is verbatim and the ultimatum is real news.
why_note_decision: The substantive claim is true: Trump did post this exact ultimatum on Truth Social on 21 March 2026 (confirmed by NBC News, Fox News, PBS, Time, Reuters). The video's overlay shows the Truth Social post, with the Truth Social header visible in the OCR ('Donald J. Trump @realDonaldTrump'). The note's nitpick — 'Trump posted on Truth Social, not X' — is technically true but irrelevant, since the tweet says 'Trump just gave' the ultimatum (he did) and the video is just a stylized presentation of the Truth Social post. The note's added claim that the video 'shows simulated tweet images that do not exist on X' misleads readers into thinking the underlying post was fabricated, when it was real (on Truth Social). 54 NNN out of 74 raters — strong consensus.
